validation.nameTooLong: Keep the name to 120 characters or fewer.
validation.cityTooLong: Keep the city to 120 characters or fewer.
validation.locationsRequired: Add at least one country or city.
validation.price: Enter a price such as 7.50 (two decimals at most).
validation.daysWhole: Enter a whole number of days.
validation.daysTooMany: Keep it to 365 days or fewer.
validation.daysOrder: The slowest delivery can't be faster than the fastest.
validation.tracking: Enter a web address (http or https) that contains {tracking_number}.
validation.trackingTooLong: Keep the link to 500 characters or fewer.

zones.description: Where you ship and at what price: each zone groups countries or cities with their own Shipping methods.
zones.formDescription: A city listed here wins over a zone that covers its whole country.
zones.deleteDescription: The zone and its Shipping methods are removed for good. Addresses it covered can't be shipped to until another zone covers them.
zones.placesHint: Leave the city empty to cover the whole country.
zones.emptyDescription: Create a zone for the countries or cities you ship to, then give it Shipping methods.
zones.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Shipping zones appear here once an Operations User adds them.
zones.notFound: This Shipping zone doesn't exist any more.

methods.title: Shipping methods
methods.description: Flat prices offered for addresses in this zone, cheapest first. Inactive methods aren't offered.
methods.formDescription: A flat price and how long delivery usually takes.
methods.deleteDescription: The method is removed for good. To stop offering it but keep it, make it inactive instead.
methods.activeHint: Only active methods are offered when an Order is created.
methods.emptyDescription: Add Standard, Express or any other way you deliver to this zone.
methods.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: This zone offers no Shipping methods yet.

quote.title: Check an address
quote.description: See which zone and Shipping methods an address gets, as Order creation will.

carriers.description: The companies that deliver your Shipments, with links customers can follow.
carriers.formDescription: A name and, if the Carrier has a tracking page, its link.
carriers.deleteDescription: The Carrier is removed for good. Carriers used by Shipments can't be deleted.
carriers.trackingHint: Put {tracking_number} where the tracking number goes. Leave it empty if there's no tracking page.
carriers.emptyDescription: Add the companies that deliver your Shipments.
carriers.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Carriers appear here once an Operations User adds them.
